profile.headline: Software Engineer | Technologist | Driven to Learn
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I'm a life-long learner who is excited by technology that drives education, productivity, and meaningful connections.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Replatforming  DailyPay's core application into microservices using Go, Kafka, Postgres, and various AWS cloud services. 

Leading data platform team to build & maintain core architecture for On Demand Pay solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Converted a paper medical questionnaire to a fully automated online form using Ruby on Rails and React.js.

Designed and wrote our system’s APIs and data models to persist our member’s data on a team of three.

Implemented designs from our UX team for various projects such our Member Dashboard and  Beam Perks page.

Handle production issues for our members, brokers, and internal teams through cross-team collaboration.

Co-facilitator of our bi-weekly technical book club where various company members discuss software principals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a cross platform mobile app for a nonprofit organization as a social good project to connect students

Learned Flutter/Dart with a team of seven interns and delivered an MVP in two weeks for the nonprofit

Used Atlassian tools such as Bitbucket, Jira, and Confluence as well as Zoom to collaborate virtually

Presented the mobile app with interactive games as a business solution to the firm and nonprofit

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Learned to use Google Cloud Platform as part of a Code Jam project which was then presented to the whole company. 

Created a web app in Node.js with five other interns for three days while teaching some teammates how to code.
            Technologies used: GCP (speech-to-text), Node.js (express framework), MySQL database, App Engine

Cleaned up a database of customer data with python by validating addresses and reformatting text for consistency 

Presented a financial report made in Power BI to executives in my Business Unit

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Designed and implemented frontend mobile solutions to improve the OnShift app’s UX on a 10-person team

Programmed automated testing and created test cases in python for Quality Assurance

Worked with a mobile and feature team at the company in an AGILE environment

positions.title: Program Co-Founder & Programming Instructor
positions.description: Created and taught a Java coding course to 7th, 8th, and 9th grade students.  Each course spanned two weeks, where students learned the basics of Java methods, classes, variables, and loops.

positions.title: Customer Service
positions.description: Handled reporting, inventory, orders, and the cash register.
